# jamfplatform_device_unmanage (Action)

Requests that Jamf Platform remove remote management from a device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "jamfplatform_device_unmanage" "retire_device" {
  config {
    device_id = "uuid-of-device-to-unmanage"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String) UUID of the device to unmanage.
